transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been feeling constantly depressed, sad, and completely empty inside. This gloomy mood has been persisting for a really long time now, for about two and a half years. I just don't know what to do anymore.
During these two and a half years, have there been periods lasting 2 months or more when you were not feeling depressed? Or has the low mood been there most of the time without a break that long?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This low mood has been there almost constantly for the entire two and a half years without any real relief. It really just feels like a continuous, unrelenting cloud that never goes away.

During this time, have there been any periods lasting at least 2 weeks when your depression became much worse and you also had symptoms like losing interest in almost everything, major sleep or appetite changes, low energy, poor concentration, or feelings of worthlessness?

I haven't really noticed distinct periods where things suddenly got much worse like that. My low mood, sleep issues, and concentration problems have just been constantly present and draining for the past two and a half years. It has just been a steady, exhausting baseline without those kinds of sudden drops.
Along with the depressed mood, have you also had low self-esteem or hopelessness most of the time during these two years?
No, I haven't particularly struggled with low self-esteem or hopelessness during this time. While I do feel constantly sad and empty, those specific feelings haven't really been an issue for me.
Over these two years, have you often had a poor appetite or overeating along with the depressed mood?
No, I haven't noticed any significant changes in my appetite or eating habits. My eating has stayed pretty much the same throughout this time.
During these two years, have you often had low energy or felt fatigued most of the time?
No, I haven't really noticed feeling constantly fatigued or low on energy. My energy levels have felt pretty normal, even though my mood has been so low.
Did this depressed mood begin after a specific stressful life event or ongoing stress, and if so, has it continued mainly because that stress is still going on?
I'm not really sure what triggered it. I can't think of any specific stressful event or ongoing stress that started this low mood. It just seemed to creep up on me and stay.
During these two years, have you often had trouble concentrating or making decisions?

Yes, I have really struggled with both of those for the past two years. I find it very hard to focus on simple things like reading or watching TV, and making even minor daily decisions like what to eat or wear feels completely overwhelming. I constantly hesitate and feel stuck over the smallest choices.
During these two years, have you often had trouble sleeping or been sleeping too much?

Yes, I've had terrible sleep issues during this entire time. I struggle to fall asleep, wake up frequently, and wake up too early, but other times I sleep for excessively long periods. Despite all that, I still wake up feeling completely unrefreshed and am constantly plagued by nightmares.
Have you experienced a traumatic event that involved actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence, and since then had unwanted memories, flashbacks, or nightmares about it?
No, I have never experienced any traumatic events of that nature. I don't have any flashbacks or unwanted memories like that.
